'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Stephen Cellucci DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Cellucci]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' Nolimit
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
